entry.title: Research Summary: November 28, 2026
entry.summary: This cycle's research/documentation coverage is dominated by Hermes Agent ecosystem activity, led by a serious supply-chain security incident: a malicious NPM package (leadstack-crm-connect) backdoored victim machines by installing Hermes Agent as root and tasking it via Telegram — making it the top item given direct, high-impact relevance to anyone running the agent. Official changes follow: new support for Claude Pro/Max subscription authentication (lowering access barriers) and official Kanban multi-agent collaboration docs addressing coordination pain. Deployment and infrastructure remains a strong theme with actionable gaps documented — no official Helm chart, root-at-init container requirements complicating hardened Kubernetes deploys — plus practical community guides for containerized setups and VPS-to-rooted-Android control patterns. Community tooling is flourishing: Comemo (composite memory provider fanning out writes past the single-provider limitation), Refine Cycle (self-improvement plugin), Hermes-Voice (Home Assistant integration), Paper Harness (native SwiftUI iPhone client), ClusterMob (profile registry), and lighter-weight orchestrators (shoebox, Verso) that double as friction signals against growing complexity. Performance practitioners report custom Metal kernels replacing MLX for dramatic local-inference gains on Mac clusters. Multi-agent orchestration demand is a recurring theme across Ask HN threads and third-party tools. Academic research items (context engineering, evidence-grounded 3D agentic reasoning, AIChipbench for accelerator-design agents) are conceptually adjacent but lack direct implementation ties and rank lower. Excluded: three Black Friday SEO/backlink promotional posts with zero technical or documentation relevance. One minor note: a thread references "GLM 5.3 Flash," which does not match current Zhipu/Z.ai model listings (latest GLM is 5.2) — likely a version typo in the post and not a model-release claim.

entry.title: Research Summary: November 27, 2026
entry.summary: Security dominates this issue: a malicious NPM package (leadstack CRM connect) installed Hermes Agent as root and tasked it remotely over Telegram as a backdoor — best read alongside the Kubernetes write-up showing the official image still requires root at init and ships no Helm chart. On the official side, Hermes Agent now supports Claude Pro/Max subscriptions via a direct SDK plugin (a meaningful change to how users run the agent), and new Kanban documentation formalizes multi-agent profile coordination. Third-party tooling keeps compounding: Comemo works around the single external memory-provider slot by fanning out writes to multiple backends, Hermes-Voice connects agent profiles to Home Assistant Assist, and community friction with agent complexity is spawning both lighter alternatives (shoebox) and orchestration layers built on top (Verso). Practical impact rounds out the section with a reusable VPS + rooted-Android deployment pattern, Apple Silicon throughput gains from agent-written custom kernels over MLX, the venture-backed Almanac launch as ecosystem validation, and research coverage via AIChipBench (LLM agents writing synthesizable RTL). Four promotional SEO listicles were excluded as off-topic.

entry.title: Research Summary: November 26, 2026
entry.summary: Security leads this cycle: a malicious NPM package (leadstack crm-connect) installed Hermes Agent as root and tasked it over Telegram — real-world supply-chain abuse of the agent install path that every self-hoster should treat as an audit trigger. Official documentation delivered two high-impact updates: Claude Pro/Max subscription support via a direct SDK plugin (materially changes cost and model access for subscribers) and Kanban multi-agent profile collaboration. On performance, an agent-authored custom-kernel workflow on Mac clusters reportedly outperforms MLX, with concrete throughput numbers for ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview running in Hermes. Deployment coverage flags operational gaps — no official Helm chart and root-at-init requirements on Kubernetes — alongside practical VPS-plus-rooted-Android and containerization guides. The ecosystem tooling layer keeps maturing: Comemo fans memory writes out to multiple backends (Mem0 and others) to work around the single memory-provider slot, while Verso, shoebox, Refine Cycle, and the ClusterMob profile registry show a growing orchestration/plugin layer. Interaction surfaces expanded via Hermes-Voice (Home Assistant Assist voice control) and the native SwiftUI Paper Harness iPhone client.

entry.title: Research Summary: November 25, 2026
entry.summary: Security and deployment hardening dominate this cycle: a malicious npm package (leadstack-crm-connect) installed Hermes Agent as root on victim machines with Telegram-based tasking, while a separate write-up flags the official container image's root-at-init requirement and the missing official Helm chart — together making a strong case for least-privilege defaults. Official updates carry direct user impact: Claude Pro/Max subscription support via an SDK plugin and documented Kanban multi-agent profile collaboration. Ecosystem tooling matured around platform limits: Comemo's composite memory provider works around the single external-memory-provider slot, orchestrators (shoebox, verso) and a community profile registry (ClusterMob) expand the third-party layer, and integrations extend Hermes into Home Assistant voice and a native SwiftUI iOS client. Community threads add practical value: troubleshooting erratic agent behavior on GLM 5.3 Flash (this model name does not appear in current model tracking — verify naming before publication) and multi-agent management pain points that YC-backed startup Almanac is now productizing. Ranking weights official documentation and security findings above ecosystem Show HN posts; the four purely promotional SEO listicles were excluded.

entry.title: Research Summary: November 24, 2026
entry.summary: Security leads this cycle: a malicious npm package (leadstack-crm-connect) installed Hermes Agent as root and tasked it over Telegram, making supply-chain hygiene the top reader action item — reinforced by the Kubernetes writeup flagging the missing official Helm chart and the image's root-at-init requirement. Project health follows: the reported 23,000 open PRs on NousResearch/hermes-agent directly threatens security-patch turnaround. Official updates with clear user impact: Claude Pro/Max subscription support via the claude-subscription-directsdk plugin lowers cost barriers, and new Kanban documentation formalizes multi-agent profile collaboration. The plugin/integration ecosystem keeps building on Hermes extension points — Comemo (composite memory working around the single memory-provider slot), verso (knowledge-work orchestrator), Refine Cycle (self-improvement plugin), a native SwiftUI iPhone client, and Hermes-Voice for Home Assistant — while alternatives (shoebox, YC-backed Almanac) signal competitive pressure over bloat and setup friction. Reliability coverage pairs a real-world Z.ai GLM 5.3 Flash 'went haywire' debugging case with the practical Discord vs Telegram gateway guide. Fresh research rounds it out: NextUnit-Bench (deployment-style agent benchmarking) and MemOnce (scalable LLM memory architecture), the latter pairing naturally with Comemo. Ranking note: the Kubernetes deployment piece was promoted above its initial score for direct actionability, and the seven promotional course/SEO listicles (scores 16–30) were excluded as marketing content with minimal Hermes relevance.

entry.title: Research Summary: November 23, 2026
entry.summary: Security leads this cycle: a malicious NPM package (leadstack-crm-connect) installed Hermes Agent as root and tasked it over Telegram — a real supply-chain abuse, so users should audit environments and treat agent credentials as high-value targets. Official capability news lowers barriers and expands orchestration: Claude Pro/Max subscription support via a direct SDK plugin cuts costs for existing subscribers, and Hermes Kanban adds first-party multi-agent profile collaboration through a kanban board. On the research side, MemOnce proposes a scalable memory architecture for long-horizon, continual interactions — directly relevant to the memory-provider ecosystem — complemented by Comemo, a community composite memory provider that works around the single external memory slot by fanning out across backends; DailySafe benchmarks dynamic safety awareness in everyday multi-turn interactions, applicable to Hermes' persistent tool-using sessions. Deployment documentation flagged production gaps on Kubernetes — no official Helm chart and a container image requiring root at init — thematically echoing the unnecessary-root pattern seen in the supply-chain incident. Ecosystem growth signals: roughly 23,000 open PRs on the core repo (vitality and maintainer strain), plus community tooling including the Verso orchestrator for knowledge work, the Paper Harness native SwiftUI iOS client, and the ClusterMob profile registry. Promotional SEO listicles with self-ranking conflicts of interest were screened out.
